text:
elaine (partnerships): quick sync — vendor (Open Source Model Co.) wants a joint marketplace + HW-bundle announcement. they want us to list a quantized variant on cloud marketplaces and include their inference-optimized hardware SKU in the bundle. timeline: target Weds 3pm PT for embargoed press.
mohit (bizdev): sounds good. main asks from their side? pricing + revenue split?
elaine (partnerships): yes pricing, co-marketing credit, and a short redistribution rider to allow us to ship quantized weights in marketplace images. also they asked for a 'preferred partner' blurb for their HW.
liam (eng-runtime): technical flags: we need a tested quantization profile and a perf matrix (latency/cost) for the specific HW SKU. also confirm model checksum + provenance before we publish.
annika (product): to prep console pages we need: model description, recommended routes (hosted vs dedicated), and a short guidance blurb for customers on when to pick the HW bundle.
legal (legal): heads up — redistribution rider sounds doable but depends on upstream license. which upstream license is the model under? public repo?
elaine (partnerships): it's listed as "source contains permissive license with attribution" in email — i'll share the provider email thread. they suggested an addendum for quantized redistribution.
jordan (hw-partner): HW partner wants the announcement co-branded and a 2-week joint beta for a few enterprise customers first. they can provide validated containers and perf numbers.
mohit (bizdev): we should formalize: (1) redistribution addendum, (2) co-marketing plan, (3) marketplace listing spec, (4) embargo and demo cadence. I'll draft term sheet.
legal (legal): please include an export controls checklist — quantized weights may change classification in some regions. include KYC for enterprise beta.
liam (eng-runtime): ops note: packaging for marketplace images must include deterministic build steps. simple manifest like: ```
- model.tar.gz (sha256:...)
- quant-profile.json
- dockerfile -> reference validated runtime
```
ops-bot: build-queue update: new validation job created (#val-3312) for quantized image tests.
annika (product): marketing needs 1-2 line customer-facing benefit statements and 1 screenshot for listing. can we get a perf graph by tomorrow EOD?
jordan (hw-partner): yes — i'll push the validated container and perf CSV by EOD.
mohit (bizdev): timeline proposal: Monday: legal + tech signoff; Tuesday: marketplace assets + marketing copy; Wed morning: embargoed PR to partners; Wed 3pm PT: publish. any objections?
legal (legal): need to review redistribution clause before Monday close. put the provider contact in thread and cc their counsel if possible.
liam (eng-runtime): i'll prioritize the perf matrix — tagging @ops-bot for validation pipeline.
elaine (partnerships): thanks all — i'll pull provider email and add to thread. tagging @legal and @jordan for the redistribution sample. if anyone can't meet the Monday deadline call it out now. :+1:
mohit (bizdev): will update draft term sheet and share in this thread by EOD today.
annika (product): adding a 1-pager mock for the marketplace listing, will drop by 6pm.
ops-bot: reminder set for Monday 09:30 PT to review legal signoff.
